## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2c017197a5f9700c3544c669e5ad84aaaba793f2`
Local-runs: none

Face: the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration alone (claim amendment 6550299396; PR body and changeset). No `packages/spec/src/**` path and no governed path in the committed tree, so no ④. Read: the diff at this head, card #28472, ruling B (6545218189), triage 6549643166.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/core` gains three exports through `export *` of `utils/cascade-delete-objects.ts`: `CASCADE_DELETE_OBJECTS_KEY` (a `Symbol.for` key, the twin of `OBJECT_SORTABILITY_KEY` / `ACTION_SWITCHED_OFF_KEY`), `attachCascadeDeleteObjects`, `readCascadeDeleteObjects`. Additive: correct as widening.
- `recordDelete.confirmCopy` deps gain an optional `cascadeLabels?: readonly string[]`. Every existing call stays valid; with it absent or empty the message is byte-identical to today (`cascade` is `''`). Widening, correct.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `useObjectActions` config gains an optional `objectLabelOf`. `resolveCascadeDeleteLabels` is a module export only: the package entry re-exports `useObjectActions` alone, so it is not on the published surface. Widening, correct.
- `@object-ui/i18n` gains `objectActions.deleteCascade` in ten catalogs; the pack's derived key type grows by one key. Widening, correct.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `getObjectSchema` results carry one more non-enumerable symbol; enumerable keys, `JSON.stringify` and spreads are unchanged (pinned in `getObjectSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects-28472.test.ts`). No accept set moves.
- Ruling B holds: no author key; the list is read from the served envelope only, nothing walks relationships (`cascade-delete-objects.ts` has no relationship read); absent ⇒ no line, `[]` ⇒ no line (triage 6549643166).

### ② Semver level

`patch` on all four packages, `Metadata-protocol: none`. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: "`none` takes **`patch`**; a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`". Matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev raised none (`open_questions` empty). Seat flags answered: bulk delete carries the line (claim amendment 6550299396 item 4); `plugin-view`'s own ObjectView dialog unchanged, recorded in Acceptance notes. PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay).

Delta review over record 6550860170 (head `2c017197`), same reviewer. Between them: `d09fee27` merges `origin/main` `9b4d1933` (clean; the PR's delta against main is unchanged, 22 files +657/−7), and `4e795d9e` adds one entry to `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`. No `packages/spec/src/**` or governed path in the committed tree.

### ① Derived judgments

- `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` (exported from `@object-ui/core`) gains `'overrides'`. The array restates the spec `ActionSchema`'s declared keys; `ba0084e4` (#28467, ADR-0146) added `overrides` to `ActionSchema` without this entry, so `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` ("lists every key the spec ActionSchema declares") is red on `main` `9b4d1933` for every ui PR. The entry restores the inventory to the spec: an action carrying the spec-declared key is no longer reported as unknown. Within the already-declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; no accept set narrows. `ActionDef` does not declare the key and the runner does not read it (the comment says so), so no runtime behaviour moves.
- Every judgment in record 6550860170 stands at this head.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `patch` on `@object-ui/core` (already in the changeset), `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

None new. The main-red fix is named in the PR body's Acceptance notes.
